text:
maya: Heads-up I opened a docs PR to add export examples for audit logs (curl + python) and a short note about retention/redaction. Please quick review.

sam: paste the snippets? I'll check SDK parity.

maya: curl: curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant=acme&retain=30d&redact=true" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"format":"ndjson","since":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"}'

sam: looks good. For python show client call not raw HTTP: from redwood import RedwoodClient; c=RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']); resp=c.audit.export(tenant_id='acme', retain='30d', redact=True, format='ndjson', since='2026-03-01T00:00:00Z'); if resp.status_code==200: print(resp.download_url)

cherise: Security/legal nit: change language to "example uses 30 days; configure retention per your policy." Call out that exports have TTL (24h) and access is logged.

maya: noted, will update wording and add export TTL + access-log sentence. Also planning to document redaction_policy values: pii-only, full, none.

sam: add tiny JSON example for policy: { "redaction_policy": "pii-only" } and one-liner explaining each.

docbot: automated-check: link-check failed for /export-guides (404)

maya: thanks, will fix links and push. ping me for final parity review.
